reviewType: Exact-hash independent follow-up on R3072-01, R3083-01, R3084-01, R3092-01, R3093-01 and new assessed-text cues

originalFindings.R3072-01: cleared: possessive number now constrained in the detector
originalFindings.R3083-01: cleared: keyed answer says pressure rather than an unspoken threat
originalFindings.R3084-01: cleared: Chinese prompt now asks about the pupil, with no invented counsellor
originalFindings.R3092-01: keyed option cleared: English and Chinese now say speaker rather than male pronoun; residual distractor cue below remains
originalFindings.R3093-01: cleared: detector accepts an inner compass and excludes a inner compass; all listening options now use gender-neutral speaker

findings.detail: The first-person listening audio never establishes speaker gender. Distractors B, C and D still say He/他, while the keyed A says the speaker/講者. A student can reject the distractors on an unsupported gender cue instead of interpreting the idiom.
findings.repair: Use the speaker/講者 consistently in B, C and D, or establish gender explicitly in the audio without distorting the source situation.

selectionRecommendation: Keep this eight-lesson batch unselected until R3092-02 is repaired and independently rechecked.
